suspects.name: Mira Chen
suspects.motive: Adrian intended to withdraw funding from Mira's research.

suspects.name: Leon Brooks
suspects.motive: Adrian had reported Leon for repeatedly neglecting security procedures.

suspects.name: Sofia Reyes
suspects.motive: Adrian planned to investigate unauthorized changes to the observatory systems.

suspects.name: Ethan Cole
suspects.motive: Adrian had rejected Ethan's proposal for a permanent research position.

clues.name: The Funding Email
clues.description: An email confirms that Adrian intended to reconsider Mira's research funding.

clues.name: The System Access Log
clues.description: A system log records an equipment-room terminal accessing the Control Room shortly before the incident. The account owner is not conclusively identified.

clues.name: The Security Roster
clues.description: The roster indicates that Leon was assigned to the Security Desk during the incident window, but does not prove he remained there.

clues.name: The Equipment Checklist
clues.description: A checklist signed by Sofia records an equipment inspection near the time of the incident. The signature has not been independently verified.

clues.name: The Power Fluctuation
clues.description: A brief power fluctuation was recorded before the incident. Its cause is unknown.

clues.name: The Observation Deck Witness
clues.description: A visitor recalls seeing someone near the Observation Deck, but cannot reliably identify the person or exact time.

clues.name: The Deleted Configuration
clues.description: A system configuration was deleted. Several authorized employees had permission to modify it.

clues.name: The Unsent Message
clues.description: A draft message suggests that Adrian planned to confront an employee about system changes, but the intended recipient is missing.
